purpose: Original-ROM declared module-load and dependency baseline for artifact comparison only; contains no firmware payloads.
evidence_scope: Derived only from the existing ramdisk-facts snapshot and extracted modules.load/modules.dep files named in sources. No module presence, boot success, runtime load success, dependency resolution success, or hardware support is inferred.

ci_policy.description: Comparison metadata only. Missing or different build artifacts require review and do not by themselves fail CI.

ordering.within_load_stage: ordered_entries preserves every source entry, including duplicates, in the original file order; order and source_line are one-based.
ordering.between_load_stages: The stage collection groups independent source lists and does not assert a combined runtime execution sequence. Recovery and normal-boot ramdisk lists are separate modes.
ordering.dependency_records: Source-record order and dependency-token order are preserved as metadata; modules.dep does not establish a requested module-load sequence.

normalization.algorithm: Take the POSIX basename, remove the exact trailing .ko suffix, and replace every hyphen with underscore. Case is preserved. All parsed source module tokens were verified to end in .ko.
normalization.unique_name_order: First occurrence within the relevant source traversal; uniqueness applies only to normalized names, and does not establish binary identity or ABI compatibility.

ramdisk_facts_container.purpose: Existing local preflight snapshot; source container for the decoded vendor-full ramdisk load-list texts and original per-member hashes.

vendor_boot_normal.purpose: Declared normal-boot vendor ramdisk module requests, in source-file order.

vendor_boot_recovery.purpose: Declared recovery vendor ramdisk module requests, in source-file order; a separate recovery list, not an extension of normal boot.

vendor_dlkm.purpose: Declared extracted vendor_dlkm_a module requests for comparison with built artifacts; preserves source-file order.

system_dlkm.purpose: Declared extracted system_dlkm_a module requests; the source file is empty and is retained as empty without inferring module absence or runtime behavior.

vendor_dlkm_dependencies.purpose: Declared dependency metadata from the extracted vendor_dlkm_a partition; paths and dependency-token order are preserved. This is not an additional load list or a runtime trace.

load_stages.purpose: Declared normal-boot vendor ramdisk module requests, in source-file order.
Declared recovery vendor ramdisk module requests, in source-file order; a separate recovery list, not an extension of normal boot.
Declared extracted vendor_dlkm_a module requests for comparison with built artifacts; preserves source-file order.
